Enter a reference height for each diameter class, in metres. Use a comma or a point for decimals; separate multiple heights with semicolons or spaces (e.g. 18.5;20;21). This reference will be applied to stems in that class in the displayed campaign: it is not an individual measurement of each tree. Other campaigns and legacy observations remain unchanged.
